title: Sam Maloof
hero_prompt: Wide 12:5 composition on a darkened warm-brown backdrop. A pair of weathered hands smoothing a deep-grained curved wooden surface — the grain flows like water around a hidden knot. The carving gouge rests beside the hand, catching a single point of light. Rendered as a richly textured woodcut print: bold incised lines, hand-printed quality, deep shadows, no CGI finish. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold square emblem in woodcut style: a single rocking-chair silhouette whose curved rocker forms the bottom arc of a circle, all high-contrast black on warm cream. The chair is a thick, readable mark that survives at 24px. Hard geometric simplicity, no fine linework, no text, no numerals.
